entry.breathQuote: I thought I was watching a survival story about good versus evil. I didn't realize I was watching the dismantling of moral certainty.

reflection.quote: It taught me that the most dangerous person in any room is the one who has completely stopped doubting their own righteousness.
reflection.whatIKept: Everyone is acting perfectly rationally based on the story they were told. There is no villain's seat in the theater of the world — only different seat assignments.
reflection.definingScene: Reiner and Bertholdt on the wall. A world-shattering truth delivered with exhausted weariness. It wasn't a villain's monologue. It was tired soldiers.
reflection.whoItMadeMeThinkAbout: Anyone I have ever quickly filed under 'enemy' without understanding their context.

thoughtCascade.thought: We are the monsters to someone else.
Everyone is just acting on the story they were told.

cinematicMoment.title: The Basement Reveal.
cinematicMoment.body: The walls weren't protecting them from monsters. They were protecting them from the truth. The moment the outside world existed, I started looking for the walls in my own beliefs.

memoryCards.question: What stayed with me after the screen went dark?

cards.title: The Ocean
cards.text: A destination that was supposed to be freedom, and turned out to be just another boundary.

cards.title: The Forest
cards.text: The cycle of hatred made physical. We have to lead the children out of it.

cards.title: The Door
cards.text: The basement door. Knowledge you can't un-know once it's opened.

altMemories.question: What quietly changed?
altMemories.heading: My definition of freedom.
altMemories.body: I used to think freedom was the ultimate virtue. Eren showed me that freedom pursued without empathy is just tyranny by another name.
altMemories.caption: Freedom as a weapon.

pullQuote.text: Everyone had to be drunk on something to keep pushing on. Everyone was a slave to something.

firstImpression.heading: A brutal action series
firstImpression.body: I came for the spectacle — ODM gear, titans, constant peril. A clean fight between humanity and monsters.

whatShifted.heading: The loss of the moral high ground
whatShifted.body: The story crossed the ocean, and I was forced to empathize with the people who caused the first three seasons.

whatStayed.heading: The danger of narrative
whatStayed.body: Propaganda and historical narrative are deadlier than any physical weapon.

items.line: when I am too sure that I'm the protagonist of a conflict.
what information I'm missing that makes the other person's actions perfectly rational to them.
to find the 'walls' I've built around my own worldview.

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.mirror: He showed me how easily the desire to protect your own can curdle into the willingness to destroy everything else.

characters.name: Erwin Smith
characters.mirror: He reflected the terrible cost of leadership — the willingness to become a demon for the sake of the truth.

characters.name: Gabi Braun
characters.mirror: She made me uncomfortable because she is exactly what Eren was. Conditioning shapes our entire reality.

notes.text: If you only look at the world from inside your walls, you will eventually burn everything outside them.

ideas.application: There is no absolute truth in human conflict, only competing narratives.

continueJourney.because: Because I now distrust anyone — including myself — who has stopped doubting.

recommendations.title: Vinland Saga
recommendations.reason: What happens when you decide you have no enemies.

recommendations.title: Code Geass
recommendations.reason: The cost of carrying the world's hatred.
